audience: Founders, macro-curious professionals, and serious retail readers who value evidence discipline.
hook_patterns: Open with a process question worth sitting with.
Lead with a tension between certainty and evidence.
body_patterns: Explain the reasoning, then the limitation.
Separate observation from thesis from conclusion.
cta_patterns: Ask what evidence would change the view.

platform_family_adaptations.x: Tighten to a single clear idea; thread only when it adds reasoning.
platform_family_adaptations.newsletter: Extended room to show the full reasoning.

default_limitations_language: Educational and general; not investment advice. Limitations and freshness stated where relevant.
